lines.t: From the Common of Holy Men and Women: For Religious

lines: O God, who choose the weak and the simple
to reveal your power and greatness;
grant us the grace to follow the example of Saint Benedict
in his spirit of service and prayer,
so that we too, like him, may be chosen instruments,
in the building of your Kingdom.
Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son,
who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit,
one God, for ever and ever.
